scope: Global macaque measurements only; no regional or homology claim

definitions.brain_volume_mm3: Count strictly positive finite brainmask.mgz voxels multiplied by MGH header voxel volume; brain-extraction support volume, not eTIV or segmentation BrainSegVol.
definitions.total_area_mm2: Sum triangle areas of the two final native white surfaces.
definitions.mean_thickness_mm: For each hemisphere, arithmetic mean of final thickness on cortex.label; retain finite zero values. Combine the two hemisphere means weighted by final white surface area. No annot or parcel means.
definitions.hull_ratio: Sum final pial triangle areas divided by sum per-hemisphere 3D convex-hull areas; not average hemisphere ratios and not local GI.
definitions.etiv_mm3: Always absent for macaque; never read aseg-derived volume/eTIV/CortexVol.

annotation_policy: 人类命名标签，不作猕猴分区

scale.final_surface_scale_k: Remaining linear multiplier in final stored coordinates relative to native MRI nominal mm; a restored output has k=1, not k=2 again.
scale.physical_calibration: MRI nominal units and processing-scale verification do not certify independent scanner calibration
